email_body:
Dear MUTANI team,

I'm applying for the Content Creator Internship. Your virtual-to-reality fashion brand sits right where my interests meet: gaming, fashion and visual storytelling. I'd love to help bring that world to Instagram and TikTok.

I'm a digital marketer with a technical background, but I've always been the person behind the camera. I shoot and edit photo and video on my smartphone, and I'm comfortable using tools like Canva and CapCut. I've built and run websites (baverok.com, mirook.com) where I created all the visual content myself, from hand-coded landing pages to product shots. I also write copy that connects, and I'm fluent in English with a quirky pen.

I'm organised, self-motivated and enjoy the pace of a small startup. I'm based in Zwijndrecht, close to Antwerp, and available part-time for at least four months, starting as soon as possible.

I've attached my resume and portfolio. I'd love to talk about how I can contribute to MUTANI's visual identity.

Warm regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
baverok.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

cv_highlights:
• Freelance SEO, AI Search & WordPress (2026–present): designed and built baverok.com and mirook.com, creating all visual content and writing copy.
• Junior Digital Marketer at Episto (2026–present): managed CMS content, wrote SEO blog posts, and maintained product catalogues for Shopify stores.
• Web & SEO Specialist at Knowledge Experts (2024–2026): built WordPress sites for clients, integrating social media and running SEO analyses.
• Front-End Developer at ViviDoctor (2018–2019): developed and optimized front-end features for a healthcare web application.
• Certifications: Semrush SEO Fundamentals and SEO Toolkit Exam (2026); Google Analytics GA4, Google Ads Search, HubSpot Content Marketing (2026).
